title: Chappell Roan Brings a Surprise Guest on Stage
summary:
Fans at Chappell Roan's concert in Los Angeles got a big surprise on Wednesday, October 21. Pop star Christina Aguilera came on stage!

Roan said Aguilera had "paved the way" for women in pop music. She called her a "legend." Aguilera said she knew Roan was special from the moment she heard her voice.

Aguilera sang her 2002 hit song "Beautiful." Then the two sang Roan's song "Coffee" together.

There was a funny moment. Roan was nervous and mixed up the first line. Aguilera laughed kindly, and Roan got back on track. They finished the song singing together.

Roan also sang "Expectations," a song by Olivia Rodrigo.

The show was the first of two nights. All the money from the concerts will go to Roan's Midwest Princess Project, which helps LGBTQ+ groups. It has raised more than $800,000 so far.
why_it_matters: It shows how stars cheer each other on, just like friends help each other.
